sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Background Check is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "How's it going, warrior? I have an errand for you. My comrade Arseny worked at the factory as a tanker driver. His family left during the evacuation while he stayed behind to make some extra money, and perished here. He lived in a three-story dormitory near Polikhim, I don't remember the room. Anyway, he had a chain watch, a family heirloom. Bragged about it to everyone. Find that watch and bring it to me, I want to send it to his kid. I want the kid to have something to remember his old man by. The watch must be either in his room or in the tanker truck somewhere at the construction site. Arseny always kept the keys in his jacket. Anyway, do the job. So long!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Obtain the bronze pocket watch on Customs
  - (Optional) Obtain the key to the fuel tanker truck
- Hand over the found item

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Prapor Rep +0.1
- 80,000 Roubles
  - 84,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
  - 92,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
"You know what? I didn't think you'd find it. But big thanks to you regardless. This was, you might say, a personal matter. Anyway, here's the reward."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Machinery key | 1 | Required | N/A | Unlocks the driver side door of the fuel truck cabin at Customs where the Bronze pocket watch is located. |
| Bronze pocket watch on a chain | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
Head into the map Customs. The Machinery key is required to access the bronze pocket watch. So if you do not have one, head to room 205 located on the second floor of the three-story dorms building in the south.

To enter the room you'll need to jump on top of debris blocking the hallway and crouch to get inside the doorway of the room. The Machinery key can be found within the blue jackets beside the wardrobe.

After obtaining the key, head north to the fuel tanker truck that is located at the construction site. The driver side door of the cabin can be unlocked with the Machinery key.

Inside, the Bronze pocket watch can be found laying on the floor in front of the seat. Be careful of the sniper Scav overlooking the truck from the roof of the nearby boiler building.

After picking up the pocket watch, it will be placed in your quest items inventory. You must successfully extract with the pocket watch to hand it in. If you die before extraction, you will have to retrieve it again. Hand the pocket watch over to Prapor to complete the quest.
